2.  **Toolkits**:

*   Sum of items: $515 \text{ (crates)} + 940 \text{ (toolkits)} + 270 \text{ (lamps)} = 1,725$
*   Subtract returned stock: $1,725 - 115 = 1,610$

Total: 1655
